title: 2398. Maximum Number of Robots Within Budget

examples.explanation: It is possible to run all individual and consecutive pairs of robots within budget. To obtain answer 3, consider the first 3 robots. The total cost will be max(3,6,1) + 3 * sum(2,1,3) = 6 + 3 * 6 = 24 which is less than 25. It can be shown that it is not possible to run more than 3 consecutive robots within budget, so we return 3.
No robot can be run that does not exceed the budget, so we return 0.
